WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, m.member_id, s.store_id, f.net_amount,
         CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
spend AS (
  SELECT member_id, SUM(net_amount) AS spend FROM lines
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07' GROUP BY 1),
tgt AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
hold AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
grp AS (SELECT member_id,'targeted' g FROM tgt UNION ALL SELECT member_id,'holdout' FROM hold)
SELECT g, count(*) n, sum(coalesce(spend,0)) total, avg(coalesce(spend,0)) mean_spend, count(spend) buyers,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lines WHERE store_id=900 AND business_date IS NULL) web_lines_no_dispatch
FROM grp LEFT JOIN spend USING(member_id) GROUP BY g

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, s.store_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.quantity,
         CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
spend AS (
  SELECT member_id, SUM(net_amount) AS spend, count(*) nl, max(net_amount) maxline, bool_or(staff_purchase_flag) staff, min(quantity) minq FROM lines
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07' GROUP BY 1),
tgt AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
hold AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
grp AS (SELECT member_id,'targeted' g FROM tgt UNION ALL SELECT member_id,'holdout' FROM hold)
SELECT g, member_id, spend, nl, maxline, staff, minq FROM (
 SELECT g, member_id, spend, nl, maxline, staff, minq, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY spend DESC) rn FROM grp JOIN spend USING(member_id)) WHERE rn<=5 ORDER BY g, rn

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (
  SELECT m.member_id,
         f.net_amount,
         CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'),
camp AS (SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15),
spend AS (
  SELECT l.member_id, SUM(l.net_amount) AS spend
  FROM lines l, camp c
  WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.window_end
  GROUP BY 1),
targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 15),
holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15),
t AS (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(sp.spend, 0)) AS avg_spend FROM targeted x LEFT JOIN spend sp USING (member_id)),
h AS (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(sp.spend, 0)) AS avg_spend FROM holdout x LEFT JOIN spend sp USING (member_id))
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name,
       ROUND(t.avg_spend, 2) AS avg_spend_targeted_eur,
       ROUND(h.avg_spend, 2) AS avg_spend_holdout_eur,
       ROUND(t.avg_spend - h.avg_spend, 2) AS uplift_eur
FROM camp c, t, h
